- Initial release of the "Video Editing with Arabic" skill.

- Fast cloud rendering with 1080p MP4 output; usually completes in 1–2 minutes.
- Simple workflow for uploading, editing, previewing, and exporting videos with Arabic captions.
- Automatic free token acquisition for new users; session setup and status messages included.
- Covers key editing actions: upload, subtitles, export, credits, and timeline previews.
